title: Stays-Bonus Rate Card by Completed Nights (Host Accounts Superhosts)
content:
# Superhost Perk Rate Card — Stays Bonus by Completed Nights (Host Accounts)

The stays bonus of a Superhost's Roamhaven travel credit on Host Accounts is paid per completed stay, at a rate set by the completed nights recorded at the completing assessment (the Superhost assessment that completed the run):

| Completed nights recorded at the completing assessment | Stays-bonus rate per completed stay |
|---|---|
| 100 or more | USD 3.00 |
| At least 50 but fewer than 100 | USD 2.00 |
| Fewer than 50 | No raised rate |

## Boundaries

| Completed nights | Rate |
|---|---|
| 100 | USD 3.00 |
| 99 | USD 2.00 |
| 50 | USD 2.00 |
| 49 | No raised rate |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A completing assessment records 120 completed nights; the stays bonus is paid at USD 3.00 per completed stay, so 14 completed stays give a stays bonus of USD 42.00. Had it recorded 64 nights, the same 14 stays would be paid at USD 2.00 each, USD 28.00.
